findings.evidence: grep 'Authors:' TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/WeightedEval/ → only Completion.lean:4; head -8 of Basic/Map/Mul/Hom/Continuous/UniversalProperty.lean shows copyright+licence and no Authors line; grep 'AINTLIB|Provenance' TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/WeightedEval/Completion.lean → no match; PR description: "Provenance: nothing ported."
findings.fix: Drop line 4 to match the rest of the `WeightedEval/` cluster; or, if the file does follow AINTLIB (or Birkbeck-directed) material, keep the line and add the `## Provenance` section naming that source, repo, licence and commit, as `RestrictedPowerSeries.lean:23-31` and `WeightedRestrictedSeries.lean:120-131` do.
findings.issue: `Authors: Chris Birkbeck` on a file whose stated provenance is "nothing ported" and whose content is a composition of Mathlib's `Completion.extensionHom`/`ext` with the repo's own `existsUnique_continuous_ringHom_weightedRestrictedSubring`. All six sibling files in `WeightedEval/` (Basic, Map, Mul, Hom, Continuous, UniversalProperty — the last being this file's direct dependency) have no Authors line, and in the Huber cluster that name otherwise accompanies an explicit AINTLIB provenance note (`StronglyNoetherian.lean:48-53`, `Continuous/Valuation.lean:40`). The header therefore credits a named individual for work the PR itself describes as composed in-repo.

summary: Sources are credited correctly (Wedhorn 5.50, the Mathlib completion API, the in-repo uncompleted 5.50), but the header names Chris Birkbeck as author with nothing in the PR supporting that credit: every other file in the WeightedEval cluster, including the direct dependency, carries no Authors line, and the PR states nothing was ported.
